title: Vitalik Buterin: Ethereum, Cryptocurrency, and the Future of Money | Lex Fridman Podcast #80
summary: Lex Fridman interviews Ethereum co-creator Vitalik Buterin about Ethereum, cryptocurrency and the future of money. The conversation also touches on technical topics such as quantum computing and mining.
why: HN recommends it as a fascinating conversation showing how the Ethereum founder thinks.

quote.text: listening to the founder of Ethereum on the Lex Fridman podcast was fascinating.
